name: optimize_prompt
description: Optimize a prompt. Returns refined version, token savings, feedback, and variants.

explain_mode.description: When true, returns detailed heuristic explanations for each of the 9 checks

token_model.description: Tokenizer model to use for primary counts: cl100k_base, o200k_base, p50k_base, r50k_base

name: capture_output
description: Capture the AI output for a previously optimized prompt to enable learning.

output.description: The AI output text to capture

prompt_id.description: The prompt ID returned from optimize_prompt

token_model.description: Optional tokenizer model override for output token count

name: get_stats
description: Get optimization stats for a user — total prompts, tokens saved, average savings.

user_id.description: User ID to fetch stats for

name: get_history
description: Get recent prompt history for a user.

limit.description: Number of recent prompts to return (max 50)

name: list_templates
description: List available per-domain prompt optimization templates.

name: count_tokens
description: Count tokens for text across supported models or a single specified model.

model.description: Optional model: cl100k_base, o200k_base, p50k_base, r50k_base

name: governance_check
description: Validate a stored prompt against governance policies.

name: governance_approve
description: Approve or reject a prompt optimization with governance tracking.

name: get_audit_trail
description: Retrieve the governance audit trail for a prompt.

prompt_id.description: The prompt ID to get audit trail for

name: sign_optimization
description: Cryptographically sign a prompt optimization record.

name: verify_signature
description: Verify the cryptographic signature and hash chain of a prompt record.

name: savings_report
description: Generate a cost savings report with token metrics, cost estimates across models, and daily trends.

user_id.description: User ID to generate report for

name: rate_optimization
description: Rate an optimization as positive or negative, enabling the learning feedback loop.

name: learning_insights
description: Get learning insights from rated optimizations — best domains, satisfaction rate, recommendations.

user_id.description: Optional user ID to filter insights

name: team_report
description: Generate a team-level analytics report aggregating savings across multiple users.

user_ids.description: List of user IDs to include. If empty, aggregates all users.
